_about: The owner's "Beanie Camper" T-pose turnaround (25 Oct 2026), the reference for this model, for art/tools/compare.py. The sheet stays in the project files, not in git. views: where each figure stands on the sheet (its middle x, the row its soles touch, in pixels); px_per_m: the sheet's pixels per metre at the model's real size; background_at: a pixel of plain backdrop; pairs: the box round each view for side-by-side crops; bands: colour samples of the front view (from and to metres above the ground, half width in metres, which pixels count, the swatch they test).
title: THE GAME'S CAMPER: SAME VIEWS, STUDIO LIGHT
